objectives.en: Define the formal and informal sectors
Compare the conditions of formal and informal workers

narration.en: One worker has a provident fund, paid leave and a union. Another, doing equally hard work, has none of these. What makes the difference?
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕನಿಗೆ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ನಿಧಿ, ವೇತನಸಹಿತ ರಜೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಘ ಇದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಕಷ್ಟಪಡುವ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬನಿಗೆ ಇವು ಯಾವುದೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಏಕೆ?

body.en: All public sector establishments and those private sector establishments which employ 10 hired workers or more are called formal sector establishments, and those who work in them are formal sector workers. All other enterprises and workers form the informal sector: farmers, agricultural labourers, owners of small enterprises and people working in them, the self-employed who do not have hired workers, and non-farm casual wage labourers. Formal workers enjoy social security benefits, earn more and can form trade unions; informal workers usually get no regular income or protection.

points.en: Formal: public sector + private units with 10 or more hired workers
Informal: farmers, small units, self-employed without hired workers, casual labourers
Formal workers: social security, higher pay, trade unions

narration.en: The formal sector is every public sector unit and every private unit with ten or more hired workers. Everyone else is in the informal sector, where workers rarely get social security or the protection of a trade union.
narration.kn: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹತ್ತು ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೂಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿರುವ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ವಲಯ. ಉಳಿದವರೆಲ್ಲ ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ವಲಯ; ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ ವಿರಳ.

narration.en: Formal-sector workers have regular jobs with social security such as provident fund and pension. Informal workers, the large majority in India, usually have none. Change the shares and see how many lack protection (millions of workers). With 10% formal jobs, how many workers lack social security? Which helps more: doubling formal jobs, or covering 30% of informal workers?
narration.kn: ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ವಲಯದ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ನಿಧಿ, ಪಿಂಚಣಿಯಂತಹ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆಯ ನಿಯಮಿತ ಕೆಲಸ. ಭಾರತದ ಬಹುಪಾಲು ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಪಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಜನ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲದವರು ನೋಡಿ (ದಶಲಕ್ಷ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು). 10% ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಿದ್ದರೆ, ಎಷ್ಟು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ? ಯಾವುದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಹಾಯ: ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಕೆಲಸ ದ್ವಿಗುಣ, ಅಥವಾ 30% ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕರಿಗೆ ಭದ್ರತೆ?

title.en: On the board: Formal and informal sectors

narration.en: Let us compare the formal and the informal sector on the board.

say.en: Let us draw a two-column table to compare the formal and the informal sector.
Who is in it? The formal sector is all public sector units, and private units with ten or more hired workers. Everyone else is informal.
Social security: formal workers get provident fund, pension and paid leave; informal workers usually get none.
Formal workers can form trade unions and bargain for fair wages. Informal workers are scattered and find this hard.
Over time more of India's workforce has moved into the informal sector. This is informalisation.

explanation.en: Formal sector workers get regular income and social security and can form trade unions. Most Indian workers are in the informal sector, without such protection.

body.en: Only a small share of India's workers are in the formal sector; the vast majority are informal. Over the years, as formal units such as textile mills closed or cut jobs, many formal workers were pushed into the informal sector, often as casual labourers or small vendors: this is informalisation. Women are found more in the informal sector. Since the informal sector is so large, the government has started schemes to modernise informal enterprises and to provide social security to informal workers.

points.en: Closures of formal units pushed workers into informal work
Government: modernise informal units, extend social security

narration.en: Most Indian workers are in the informal sector, and when formal units like textile mills closed, many workers were pushed into informal jobs. The government now tries to modernise informal enterprises and give informal workers social security.
narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಘಟಕಗಳು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಅನೇಕರು ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳಲ್ಪಟ್ಟರು. ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಭದ್ರತೆ ನೀಡಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.

problem.en: Classify each as formal or informal sector: (a) a private factory with 25 hired workers, (b) a tailor who works alone at home, (c) a clerk in a state-government office, (d) a shop with 4 hired helpers.

steps.en: (a) Private unit with 10 or more hired workers: formal.
(b) Self-employed with no hired workers: informal.
(d) Private unit with fewer than 10 hired workers: informal.

body.en: A unit is formal if it is in the public sector, or if it is private and hires ten or more workers. Fail both and it is informal.
